body:
Skype: samuelrutledge12
PVP: 8.5/10

Archery: 10/10 (im a pretty good shot, had a few 60-70+ shots)

Strategic: 9/10
Pros: I am good at 1v1, but probably couldn't beat everyone. I would be a good defense, shooting people if they get past the front lines (my preferred position are the midfield or a rusher...although i wouldn't mind any position). Im also on probably 4+ hours everyday that im on, about 5 days a week in a normal week. Im open at about any time during the day.

Cons: Not the best at pvping, still good though, i always get knocked off edges for some reason xD. Im also pretty bad at parkour.

Position: Rusher or midfielder.
